description: This file defines client-side API functions for searching and fetching recipe data from third-party providers (Spoonacular and Edamam), and from a backend proxy if configured. It handles environment variable configurations, request constructions, and normalization of data responses.

methods.name: getBackendBase()
methods.description: Determines the base URL for backend proxy API calls based on environment variable.

methods.name: hasSpoonacularKey()
methods.description: Checks if the Spoonacular API key is configured.

methods.name: hasEdamamKeys()
methods.description: Checks if the Edamam API ID and key are configured.

methods.name: buildQuery(params)
methods.description: Constructs URL search parameters from given parameters object.

methods.name: fetchJson(url, init)
methods.description: Performs a fetch request and returns JSON data, throwing an error on HTTP failure.

methods.name: searchRecipes({ ingredients, maxBudgetUsd, diet, maxReadyMinutes })
methods.description: Public function to search for recipes across providers or via backend proxy, with fallback mock data.

methods.name: getRecipeDetails({ provider, id })
methods.description: Public function to fetch detailed recipe information by provider and ID, with fallback for local data.

ctags.name: searchRecipes
ctags.pattern: /^export async function searchRecipes({ ingredients, maxBudgetUsd, diet, maxReadyMinutes }) {$/
